commandCenter.title: Command Center
commandCenter.intro: What needs your attention first, then the measured state of your site: events, consent, destinations, deliveries, queue and plan usage.

noSite.title: No site yet
noSite.text: Create your first site to get a tracking ID. The Command Center then measures everything from that site's own data.

partial.title: Some measurements are unavailable
partial.text: These could not be measured right now and are shown as unavailable: {list}. Nothing is estimated in their place.

priority.heading: Priorities
priority.attentionCount: {n, plural, =0 {No further problems} one {# further problem} other {# further problems}}
priority.attentionEmpty: No further problems from the {n} checks that ran.
priority.rulesIntro: Actions come from fixed rules evaluated in a fixed order: critical first, then warnings, then suggestions; within a level the earlier rule wins. A rule only fires on measured values — nothing is estimated.

none.title: No action needed right now
none.text: {checked} checks ran at {time} and none found a problem.

site_paused.title: Resume tracking for {site}
site_paused.why: {reason, select, kill_switch {The kill switch is on: incoming events are rejected until it is turned off.} other {The site is paused: incoming events are rejected until it is resumed.}}
site_paused.rule: Fires when the site status is “paused” or its kill switch is on.

usage_hard_limit.title: Plan limit reached — processing is paused
usage_hard_limit.why: {used} of {limit} billable events were counted in {period} and the hard limit was hit under the “{policy}” overage policy. Events are not processed until you upgrade or allow overage.
usage_hard_limit.rule: Fires when the current usage period carries a hard-limit timestamp.

no_config.title: Publish a configuration for {environment}
no_config.why: No configuration version is active in the {environment} environment, so the snippet has nothing to load and no event is accepted.
no_config.rule: Fires when the active environment has no active configuration version.

no_events.title: Install the snippet and send a first event
no_events.why: A configuration is live in {environment}, but no event has reached Track for this environment yet (tracking ID {trackingId}).
no_events.rule: Fires when a configuration is active and the event store holds no event for the environment.

credentials.title: {count, plural, one {Fix the credentials of {destination}} other {Fix credentials for # destinations}}
credentials.why: {kind, select, expired {The credential of {destination} has expired} expiring {A credential of {destination} expires within {days} days} oauth {The OAuth connection of {destination} is no longer connected} other {The last health check of {destination} reported a credential error}}; deliveries to it fail or will start failing.
credentials.rule: Fires when a connected destination has an expired credential, a credential expiring within {days} days, a disconnected OAuth connection or a failed credential health check.

dead_letters.title: {count, plural, one {Replay # dead-lettered delivery} other {Replay # dead-lettered deliveries}}
dead_letters.why: {count, plural, one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}} exhausted all retries and will not be sent again without a replay.
dead_letters.rule: Fires when unreplayed dead-letter references exist for the site.

delivery_failures.title: Investigate delivery failures
delivery_failures.why: {failed} of {attempts} delivery outcomes in the last {hours} hours were failures ({pct}); the threshold is {thresholdPct}. Most common error class: {errorClass}.
delivery_failures.rule: Fires from {minAttempts} outcomes in {hours} hours with a failure share of {thresholdPct} or more; critical from {criticalPct}.

critical_issues.title: {count, plural, one {Resolve # critical data quality issue} other {Resolve # critical data quality issues}}
critical_issues.rule: Fires when open issues with severity “critical” exist.

usage_soft_limit.title: Plan limit almost reached
usage_soft_limit.why: {pct} of the plan limit is used ({used} of {limit} billable events in {period}). Above 100 % the “{policy}” overage policy applies.
usage_soft_limit.rule: Fires from {thresholdPct} of the monthly event limit.

destination_errors.title: {count, plural, one {Check destination {name}} other {Check # destinations with errors}}
destination_errors.why: {count, plural, one {{name} is in the error state} other {{name} and # more are in the error state}}; deliveries to it are not attempted.
destination_errors.rule: Fires when a destination has the status “error”.

silence.title: No events for {hours} hours
silence.why: The last event in {environment} arrived {lastAt}; the threshold is {threshold} hours. Check the snippet, the domain and the consent banner.
silence.rule: Fires when the production environment received events before but none within {threshold} hours.

no_consent_policy.title: Publish a consent policy
no_consent_policy.why: {status, select, none {No consent policy exists for this site} other {The consent policy is still in the “{status}” state}}, so region rules and purposes are not enforced.
no_consent_policy.rule: Fires when the site has no published consent policy.

consent_coverage.title: Check the consent integration
consent_coverage.why: Only {pct} of {events} events carried an explicit consent signal; the threshold is {thresholdPct}. Events in the default state can be blocked for marketing destinations.
consent_coverage.rule: Fires from {minEvents} events when the explicit-signal share is below {thresholdPct}.

duplicates.title: Reduce duplicate events
duplicates.why: {deduplicated} of {received} events received in the last {hours} hours were duplicates ({pct}); the threshold is {thresholdPct}.
duplicates.rule: Fires from {minReceived} received events in {hours} hours with a duplicate rate of {thresholdPct} or more.

queue_lag.title: Deliveries are delayed by {minutes} minutes
queue_lag.why: The oldest waiting message has been queued for {seconds} seconds ({pending} waiting); the threshold is {thresholdMinutes} minutes.
queue_lag.rule: Fires when the oldest ready message of your organization has waited {thresholdMinutes} minutes or more.

warning_issues.title: {count, plural, one {Review # data quality warning} other {Review # data quality warnings}}
warning_issues.why: Open warnings usually mean missing parameters or unplanned events.
warning_issues.rule: Fires when open issues with severity “warning” exist.

usage_warning.title: {pct} of the plan limit used
usage_warning.why: {used} of {limit} billable events in {period}. Plan ahead before {nextPct}.
usage_warning.rule: Fires from {thresholdPct} and below {nextPct} of the monthly event limit.

domain_unverified.title: Verify {hostname}
domain_unverified.why: The domain is not verified yet. Verification proves ownership and unlocks first-party delivery options.
domain_unverified.rule: Fires when the site's primary domain has no verification timestamp.

no_destinations.title: Connect a first destination
no_destinations.why: Events arrive, but no destination is configured, so nothing is delivered.
no_destinations.rule: Fires when events exist and the site has no destination.

siteStatus.label: Site
siteStatus.help: Whether the site accepts events. A paused site and the kill switch reject everything at the edge.

config.label: Configuration
config.help: The signed configuration version the snippet loads in this environment.

lastEvents.label: Last event
lastEvents.help: When the last browser and server event reached Track for this environment.

health.label: Health score
health.help: Tracking Health Score from 0 to 100, computed by the worker from consent, coverage, schema, duplicates, delivery and liveness.

consent.label: Consent coverage
consent.help: Share of accepted events whose consent came from an explicit signal (CMP, API, TCF, GPP, GPC) rather than the default state.

destinations.label: Destinations
destinations.help: Connected destinations of this site and any credential or OAuth problems.
destinations.errors: {n, plural, one {# with errors} other {# with errors}}
destinations.credentials: {n, plural, one {# credential problem} other {# credential problems}}

duplicates.label: Duplicate rate
duplicates.help: Events the ingest stage recognised as repeats of an already accepted event, over the last 24 hours.

delivery.label: Delivery errors
delivery.help: Failed and dead-lettered delivery outcomes over the last 24 hours.
delivery.deadLetters: {n, plural, one {# dead letter} other {# dead letters}}

queue.label: Queue lag
queue.help: How long the oldest message has been waiting for a worker in your organization's delivery queues.
queue.pending: {n, plural, one {# message waiting} other {# messages waiting}}
queue.inFlight: {n, plural, one {# in flight} other {# in flight}}
queue.notMeasurable: Not measurable with the current queue driver

usage.label: Plan usage
usage.help: Billable events of the current period against the monthly limit of your plan.

flow.title: Event flow
flow.caption: Accepted, deduplicated and dropped events per hour over the last 24 hours
flow.empty: No events were recorded in the last 24 hours.

delivery.title: Delivery outcomes
delivery.caption: Delivered, failed and dead-lettered delivery attempts per day over the last 7 days
delivery.empty: No delivery attempts in the last 7 days.

recentEvents.title: Last verified events
recentEvents.intro: The most recent accepted events of this environment with their consent, processing state and deliveries. Payloads are never shown here.
recentEvents.caption: Recent accepted events

empty.title: No accepted events yet
empty.text: As soon as the snippet or a server integration sends events, the last accepted ones appear here with their consent, state and deliveries.

footer.note: Every number on this page is read from the tables of {site} ({environment}). Unknown stays unknown: nothing is estimated or filled in.
